angle: level, lens on the water surface
start_frame: One insert at water level: the white kid gloves and the large fan hitting the surface, the first ripple rings starting to cross.
end_frame: The same frame two seconds later: the gloves and fan settling and beginning to drift, a white shape already going away small up the flooded hall behind them.
constraint_honoured: 'He is gone from the episode in two seconds — do not extend.'
movement_note: No move, no pan after him: the objects stay and he leaves, which is what makes the fan and the glove available as the scene's last two white things.
